answer.headline: Conversion rate dropped beyond normal variation due to a checkout issue affecting Android users.
explanation: Overall conversion rate fell significantly compared to typical weekly changes.
The primary candidate cause is the Android operating system, which experienced a steep drop in checkout start rates after adding items to the cart.
This issue began impacting users and diverging from the rest of the site starting on Mon 14 Dec 2020.
answer.next_step: Investigate recent releases or tags affecting the checkout funnel specifically for Android users.
